description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of git svn with respect to internationalization (i18n) commit encoding settings. It sets up repositories, performs commits with different encodings, and verifies that commit and log messages match expected encodings, particularly focusing on how git-svn honors i18n.commitEncoding configurations.

methods.name: compare_git_head_with
methods.description: Compares the current git HEAD commit message with the content of a specified file to ensure consistency.

methods.name: prepare_utf8_locale
methods.description: Prepares the environment to use a UTF-8 locale for testing purposes.

methods.name: compare_svn_head_with
methods.description: Extracts log messages from svn and compares them with expected files to verify encoding correctness.
